description: Unit test class for the UriEncoding utility, testing various encoding and decoding functions related to URI components in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.gateway.endpoints.utils package.

classes.name: UriEncodingTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing URI encoding and decoding functionalities in UriEncoding utility.

methods.name: specialCharsWithoutEncodingRelaxed
methods.description: Tests creation of URIs with special characters using relaxed and strict modes, expecting exceptions for unsupported characters.

methods.name: specialCharsWithoutEncodingStrict
methods.description: Tests creation of URIs with special characters in strict mode, expecting exceptions for unsupported characters.

methods.name: specialCharsWithEncoding
methods.description: Tests encoding of combined supported and unsupported characters in URI paths.

methods.name: encodePath
methods.description: Tests encoding of complete path strings into URI-safe formats.

methods.name: encodePathSegment
methods.description: Tests encoding of individual URI path segments.

methods.name: encodeQueryRfc3986
methods.description: Tests encoding of query strings according to RFC3986.

methods.name: encodeQueryParamRfc3986
methods.description: Tests encoding of individual query parameters following RFC3986.

methods.name: encodeQueryFormUrlEncoded
methods.description: Tests encoding of query strings according to application/x-www-form-urlencoded standards.

methods.name: encodeQueryParamFormUrlEncoded
methods.description: Tests encoding of individual query parameters as form URL encoded.

methods.name: decodeRfc3986InvalidSequence
methods.description: Tests that invalid percent-encoding sequences throw an exception.

methods.name: decodeFormUrlEncoded
methods.description: Tests decoding of form URL encoded strings.

methods.name: decodeFormUrlEncodedInvalidSequence
methods.description: Tests that invalid sequences in form URL encoding throw an exception.
